resources.name: Vapor pressure data of Li, Li₂, LiO, Li₂O over Li₂O(s)

access.notes: Provided as part of the task resources (vapor_pressures.csv). Contains columns: T (K), p_Li (atm), p_Li2 (atm), p_LiO (atm), p_Li2O (atm) from Table 1 of the source.
Provided as part of the task resources (constants.json). Contains ionization cross‑sections, isotope abundances, multiplier gains, and the pressure calibration constant k.

Free‑energy functions (G_T–H_0)/T for Li₂O(s), Li₂O(g), Li(g), LiO(g) and standard heats of formation for Li₂O(s), Li(g), O(g) are publicly available from the NIST‑JANAF database or published literature. The checker will have a pre‑computed table of the required free‑energy differences hardcoded in tests/.
